title: Pretty pattern but muted/matted colors-
text:
Pretty pattern but muted/matted colors-. Looking for a shower curtain to make a bold and beautiful statement in the guest bathroom.. like a piece of added art! I loved the bright colors and boho pattern this offered- however, matted hues feel a bit “washed” and although I like that feel with certain things… A shower curtain is not one place I want something to look a tad bit weathered!? This is actually one place I would appreciate a higher sheen and feel it would provide a newer and more confident look. (Guess I just don’t want my shower curtain looking comfortable and worn in- even though it isn’t!?)

Made from a very thick material- it may add to reason this doesn’t have that high polished finish.. and this definitely is a heavier curtain! x1 that has capability to keep water inside tub space.. and made of solid quality in materials and finishings. I find a downside to use of the heavier fabric with this print comes in the fact- this can be a powerful presence.. and actually overtake and make ones bathroom appear/feel smaller. So just be careful in space you’re using- heavier fabric, busier pattern and bold colors tend to close in the space.. especially in this large of size- it does so far more than if it had a soft sheen to the overall material!

Possibly a solid option for some bathrooms and spaces… Just seems to lack the sheen + feel given in photos that I was expecting. Considering these points prior to ordering and I’m certain you’ll be happy with your purchase! Hoping this info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone.
